vocabulary.meaning: consciousness. Six kinds, one per sense — the knowing that arises when a sense meets its object, and itself a place craving can lodge
contact — the meeting of sense, object and consciousness. The survey moves to it once all six consciousnesses have been named
mind-objects, here as the sixth external base — what the mind meets, paired with mind exactly as forms are paired with the eye
